datasets.title: Central Asia seismic hazard (SFRARR)
datasets.description: Historical and probabilistic seismic hazard data for Central Asia: earthquake catalogue, fault database, OpenQuake model, stochastic event set, hazard maps and curves, disaggregation and scenario footprints.
datasets.purpose: Regional risk modelling. These data have been derived on a regional scale for the purpose of consistent regional multi-country hazard and risk assessment. Application of this information on smaller scales should be done with care. Importantly on a local scale, it is often the case that more detailed history and hazard information is required to perform such hazard and risk modelling, particularly where applied to dimension mitigation structures or strategies.

project.name: SFRARR - Strengthening Financial Resilience and Accelerating Risk Reduction in Central Asia

datasets.details: Data from the EU-funded 'Strengthening Financial Resilience and Accelerating Risk Reduction in Central Asia' Program (https://www.gfdrr.org/en/program/SFRARR-Central-Asia). Data and results of a new probabilistic earthquake hazard model for Central Asia, calibrated on a newly developed regional earthquake catalogue harmonized between countries and homogenized in moment magnitude (Mw) using the most up-to-date information from global and local sources. A new seismogenic source zonation model was developed in cooperation with the scientific representatives of the five countries included. Mapped active faults from regional datasets were used to create finite fault source models and new regionalized selection of ground motion model is proposed in a new logic tree structure. All hazard calculations were carried using the OpenQuake open-source engine.

resources.title: Central Asia seismic hazard scenario footprints

resources.title: Hazard maps of the SFRARR PSHA model for Central Asia
resources.description: Mean hazard maps of the SFRARR Central Asia Probabilistic Earthquake Hazard Model computed with the OpenQuake calculation engine for a site grid of 0.2 degrees. resources.title: Stochastic event set - Stochastic earthquake catalogue
resources.description: Stochastic earthquake catalogue for 10.000 years simulation time of the SFRARR Central Asia Probabilistic Earthquake Hazard Model computed with the OpenQuake calculation engine for six selected target sites. Stochastic event set (earthquake catalogue) computed for 10.000 years simulation time. Each event is associated to a rupture (rup_id). Logic tree is randomly sampled according to relative branch weighting. Files are in OpenQuake format.

resources.title: Stochastic event set - Stochastic ground motion fields
resources.description: Stochastic ground motion fields of the SFRARR Central Asia Probabilistic Earthquake Hazard Model computed with the OpenQuake calculation engine for six selected target sites. Ground motion fields for each rupture of the 10.000 years stochastic earthquake catalogue computed for different intensity measure types (IMT: PGA, SA0.1s, SA0.2s, SA0.5s, SA1.0s, SA2.0s, SA3.0s) at six selected target sites (Almaty, Ashgabat, Bishkek, Dushanbe, Nur-Sultan and Tashkent). Files are in OpenQuake format.

resources.title: Stochastic event set - Average ground motion fields

Files are in OpenQuake format.

resources.title: Stochastic event set - Stochastic Inter-event uncertainty
resources.description: Inter-event uncertainty of the stochastic catalogue of the SFRARR Central Asia Probabilistic Earthquake Hazard Model computed with the OpenQuake calculation engine for six selected target sites. resources.title: Stochastic event set - Selected target sites
